title: enrtlMixedSolvent operation
description: Mixed-solvent eNRTL bench: the mean-ionic activity coefficient of a salt in water-alcohol mixtures, regressed system by system against published data. The case SPELLS OUT the binary tau parameters and the alcohol's own constants so it reads as its own citation — defaults exist (the published water-ethanol-NaCl set) but a case that states them teaches where every number came from. Each entry of `systems` is one solvent composition with its Debye-Hückel A_phi and its measured (m, gamma) points; the op reports the deviation per system.

salt.title: Salt tau parameters
salt.description: The four eNRTL binary interaction parameters of the salt with each solvent (e.g. tau_OH_ca / tau_ca_OH for water, tau_C2_ca / tau_ca_C2 for the alcohol). Keys are the published table's own names.

alcohol.title: Alcohol constants
alcohol.description: The co-solvent's own eNRTL constants: `{ X ...; Z ...; MW ...; }`.

systems.title: Solvent compositions with data
systems.description: One entry per solvent composition: `{ wtAlcohol <wt%>; Aphi <A_phi>; data ( { m ...; gamma ...; } ... ); }` — the alcohol mass fraction, the Debye-Hückel constant OF THAT MIXTURE, and the measured points the prediction is held against.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
